answers.explanation: Only a cluster survives the loss of a whole machine.
Multiple cores on one chip: multicore.
The idle watcher is in hot-standby mode.
SMP: each processor performs all tasks.
Speedup is less than N×, and a program written for one CPU may not use the second at all.
HPC clusters need programs written to use parallelization.
Service continues in proportion to the hardware that's left.
Cluster nodes have their own memory and OS, linked by a network.
